fabrication: DLP printing: 405 nm; PEGDA 98 wt%, BAPO 2 wt%; layer 50 um, 8 s per layer
Partial carbonization: 350 C, 4 h, inert environment; scaffold retained
Separate thermal evaporation of p-Sb2Te3 and n-Bi2Te3 on the scaffolds; film thickness about 1 um
10 p-n pairs connected in series using nickel electrodes and Ag-Sn solder; ceramic plates; assembly annealed at 220 C
interpretation: Designed open lattice pores; retained hybrid carbon core with thermoelectric shell; panels e-i are structural characterization
